summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K confirming the amount of Interest on Capital (IoC) previously approved by its Board on April 15, 2026. The gross amount per share is R$0.11421932485, subject to 17.5% withholding tax, yielding a net of R$0.09423094300 per share. The record date is April 27, 2026, with shares trading ex-interest thereafter, and payment by April 30, 2027. This is a periodic capital return distribution, akin to a dividend, not a special event. No share buybacks or treasury cancellations occurred. What to watch: confirmation of payment date over the next year.
